entries.title: Crewmates on another computer receive the plan and starting work
entries.body: When a crewmate on another computer builds on an earlier task, it now gets the plan card you chose, with its pictures and recordings, and the earlier task's work to start from. If any of it can't be copied, the task doesn't start; an older Firstmate on that computer needs updating first.
entries.noPicture: This change transfers files and saved work before the crewmate starts, with no changed visual surface.
